name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: When the sky breaks apart

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: And when the stars fall, scattering

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: And when the seas are erupted

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
ar: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: No! But you deny the Recompense

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: Noble and recording

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: They know whatever you do

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: And never therefrom will they be absent

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
en: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense

name: Al-Infitar · الإنفطار
ar: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ
en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah

name: Al-Mutaffifin · المطففين
en: Woe to those who give less [than due]

name: Al-Mutaffifin · المطففين
ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full

name: Al-Mutaffifin · المطففين
en: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss

name: Al-Mutaffifin · المطففين
en: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

name: Al-Mutaffifin · المطففين
en: For a tremendous Day

name: Al-Mutaffifin · المطففين
en: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds
